title: Access 125 Ride Connect (Track Edition)
description: Representing Suzuki's prowess in the Commuter Scooter class, the Suzuki Access 125 Ride Connect (Track Edition) is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. A 125cc powerplant pumps out 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Step-Through Upright layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
